messages:
ops-bot: PAGER: high-backpressure detected on dedicated-pool-us-west-2 — queue_depth=2400, p95_latency=2.4s, error_rate=5.8% — routed to #eng-oncall
mira: acked. I'm pulling pool metrics and autoscaler events.
ash: on call. can you paste current pool config?
mira: replicas=12, max_replicas=16, autoscale_signal=latency, burst_capacity=off, kv_cache_policy=default
mira: quick glance at logs: lots of 503s from backend kvcache with OOM-ish traces during long-gen requests (seqs ~3500). Also seeing client retries every 5s.
oliver: support is flagging two big customers running batch jobs against that pool. looks like repeated churn + long sequences.
mira: mitigation proposal (short window):
- enable burst_capacity for dedicated-pool-us-west-2 (+10 ephemeral workers)
- set max_replicas to 40 temporarily
- apply per-customer soft-rate-limits for top 2 offenders (sustain 6r/min, burst 12)
- enforce a temporary rule to respond with Retry-After for requests >3000 tokens
- enable aggressive KV prefix caching for model-bert-x (30m window)
nash: +1. I'll flip pool toggles. Mira, can you craft the rl rules? I'll coordinate the pool ops.
mira: creating rules now (simplified):
```
redwoodctl rl add --pool dedicated-pool-us-west-2 --match "client in [\"CUST-77\",\"CUST-88\"] and seq_len>3000" --limit 6r/m --burst 12 --duration 45m --reason "emergency surge"
```
mira: and CLI to enable burst + bump max:
```
redwoodctl pools update dedicated-pool-us-west-2 --set burst_capacity=enabled --reason "emergency: autoscale lag"
redwoodctl pools update dedicated-pool-us-west-2 --set max_replicas=40 --reason "emergency: surge"
```
nash: ops accepted, API returned op_id op_3b2f. provisioning may take ~2m.
ops-bot: OP: pool-update(op_3b2f) acknowledged — expected provisioning time ~120s
mira: also adding a light-weight global throttle for very long requests: any request >4000 tokens gets immediate 429 with Retry-After=20s for 30m. cuts down on concurrent KV memory pressure.
oliver: support pinged customers; one says they can throttle on their side, the other says jobs are scheduled by batch system and can't easily change. asking for mitigation options.
mira: for that one, apply tighter cap and escalate if they don't comply. i'm enabling cache policy for model-bert-x now to reduce repeated KV reads.
ops-bot: METRIC: queue_depth(dedicated-pool-us-west-2) dropped 2400 -> 600 in 95s after applying burst and max_replicas change. p95_latency=0.8s, error_rate=1.4%
mira: nice. still seeing retries from CUST-88; may be client-side backoff missing. oliver, ask them to pause or back off.
oliver: done. they're pausing heavy jobs now.
nash: cost note: increasing max_replicas to 40 will exceed reserved capacity charge bands. marking change as emergency and tagging finance ops. we'll schedule rollback to 16 when stable.
mira: adding watcher that will autocancel changes when stable:
```
watcher create --expr "queue_depth<250 and error_rate<0.5" --duration 12m --on_success "pools update --pool dedicated-pool-us-west-2 --set max_replicas=16 && pools update --pool dedicated-pool-us-west-2 --set burst_capacity=off" --notify #eng-oncall
```
nash: note: deprovisioning rate limited to 3 replicas/sec to avoid dropping inflight. also enabling elevated hs logs for 10m to capture kvcache traces.
mira: handoff plan: i'm scheduled to hand off to ash in ~20m. if watcher hasn't rolled back by then, i'll leave detailed note and handoff message. ash, you'll be primary after that.
nash: copy. i'll monitor watcher and metrics. if the watcher doesn't trigger within 40m, escalate to infra-team for kernel-level kvcache debugging.
oliver: support: two affected customers updated: CUST-77 reported immediate improvement, CUST-88 paused jobs and will coordinate with us next week for longer term fixes.
ops-bot: INCIDENT: mitigations applied; monitoring continuing. next check-in automated in 10m.
mira: post-incident action items:
- add queue_depth and memory_pressure signals to autoscaler (so scale-up reacts to backlog/mem not just latency) — owner: oliver
- implement a short-term knob to allow emergency burst_capacity toggles with soft-cost-guardrails — owner: n/a (infra)
- add client-facing guidance for exponential backoff headers and Retry-After handling — owner: product

nash: handoff: mira -> nash at 1809013615. mira, anything else for me?
mira: please watch the watcher and confirm rollback triggers. if not, validate kvcache OOMs and keep support loop active. i'll be reachable. handing off now.
ops-bot: HANDOFF: oncall changed from mira to nash (at 1809013615)
ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: final metrics: queue_depth=40, p95_latency=0.5s, error_rate=0.1% — resolved at 1809013700
ash: great work team. i'll draft a short postmortem and follow up on autoscaler changes.
support: customers notified and confirmed improved performance. keeping ticket open for follow-ups.
mira: thanks all. will add a formal runbook entry for burst toggles and watcher creation.
